segments.vv66:1.3: Tathūpamaṃ tuyhamidaṃ vimānaṃ, obhāsayaṃ tiṭṭhati antalikkhe.
segments.vv66:2.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv66:3.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv66:4.3: Annañca pānañca pasannacittā, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adamha.
segments.vv66:5.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
